title: Conductors let heat or electricity move through them easily
summary: Conductors are materials that easily transfer heat or electricity.
body: NASA's insulator guide says conductors are materials that easily transfer heat or electricity. A nearby sentence says conductors allow heat to transfer easily, while insulators resist that transfer. The electricity half of the definition is the vocabulary line, not a wiring diagram. Which metals belong on the list is not printed there. Insulators, which slow heat, are a different card.

sources.title: NASA's Our World: Insulators, educator guide EG-2010-06-008-LaRC
sources.author: NASA
sources.note: NASA eClips educator guide, U.S. government work, public domain. Product code dated June 2010. Supports the vocabulary line that conductors easily transfer heat or electricity.
